tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: List engine and browser capabilities: WebGPU adapter, float formats, decoders loaded, manifest version, which doors are open.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: One bounded read of the whole situation: document, revision, layer tree summary, active layer, selection bounds, non-default develop settings, undo depth, staged actions. Never returns pixels.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: Page through the layer tree below a group, 100 rows per page.

tools.name: get_develop
tools.description: Return every develop setting of a RAW layer, defaults included, in displayed units.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Render the composite or one layer and return a JPEG (max edge 2048 px), or a 1:1 region capped at 1024 x 1024.

tools.name: get_histogram
tools.description: Return a 256-bin histogram per channel of the composite or one layer, with clipped-pixel counts.

tools.name: sample_color
tools.description: Return the colour at a point or the mean of a box, in linear Rec.2020, sRGB and Lab.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Page through the edit list: each entry's command, door, arguments and resulting revision, 50 per page.

tools.name: get_staged
tools.description: List staged actions waiting for the person's confirmation.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Return the state of a render or export job.

tools.name: list_folder
tools.description: List the photos in the granted workspace folder with ratings, flags, labels and whether a sidecar exists.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List develop presets and LUTs in the workspace folder.

tools.name: grant_folder
tools.description: Ask the person to pick a workspace folder. The browser requires a user gesture, so an agent cannot call it.
tools.personOnlyReason: File System Access needs a user gesture and the grant is the person's authorisation.
tools.revisionExempt: Person-only workspace grant; not a document edit.
tools.agentVisible: listed so the agent knows the act exists; a call returns status person_only and names the UI control

tools.name: open_photo
tools.description: Open a photo from the workspace (RAW, JPEG, PNG, WebP, layered TIFF, PSD, or a saved .atelier document) as a new document, or as a layer (a group for PSD and TIFF) in the current one.
tools.revisionExempt: Creates a new document or appends a layer; nothing it could overwrite is stale. When asLayer is true the layer joins at the top and the new revision is returned.

tools.name: new_document
tools.description: Create an empty document.
tools.revisionExempt: Creates a new document; there is no prior revision.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save the document as .atelier, or a RAW photo's develop sidecar, in the workspace folder. Writes by temp file plus rename; never touches originals.

revision.description: Document revision this call was planned against; stale values return status 'stale'.

tools.writesWorkspace: Writes files in the workspace at once (temp file, then rename). Not on the undo stack: undo changes the document, not files already written. Replacing a preset that exists waits for the person.

tools.name: export_image
tools.description: Export the composite (or each layer with layers: true) as jpeg, png, webp, avif, tiff16, tiff-layered or psd. Display P3 works for png, jpeg, webp and tiff16; rec2020 for tiff16 only; psd and tiff-layered are sRGB at full size. Staged: the person confirms before the file is written.

revision.description: Document revision this call was planned against; stale values return status 'stale'.

layers.description: Write each visible top-level layer (a group as its composite) to its own file at canvas size; path names the folder; files are <folder>/<nn>-<layer name>.<ext>. Not with psd or tiff-layered.

tools.name: confirm_staged
